skills.description_zh:
Generate short-drama videos end-to-end via the Agnes AI API
(a.k.a. PavoAPI, served by Sapiens AI). Two-stage pipeline:

Stage 1 — Asset Pipeline: generate character / scene / prop key
visuals via agnes-image-2.1-flash, audit them with a TWO-GATE
system — G1 file-level hard inspection (format / dimensions /
square / face-ratio, see scripts/asset_inspector.py) then G2
multimodal scoring (resolution, defects, style consistency,
card compliance) using agnes-2.5-flash multimodal understanding,
retry failures, catalog approved assets to assets/index.json
with public URLs. Characters are generated as a 6-pose asset
pack (front_anchor / side_45 / full_body_riding / 3 expressions)
at 1024x1024 square with bilingual bust-composition prompts.
Then render an ASSET-REVIEW HTML gallery (assets/review.html)
for human sign-off BEFORE any video budget is spent.
Stage 2 — Episode Production (v0.9.0: FOUR STRUCTURAL GATES +
CROSS-SHOT FACE LOCK):
writer agent produces a shot table referencing asset IDs (and,
when given source_doc/source_facts/beats, writes FROM the source
novel); consistency-checker gates era/forbidden terms; the
STORYBOARD gate compiles + validates the ToonFlow 六铁律 and
aborts the whole episode on any error; a continuity BASELINE
locks cross-shot staging + a story state machine; shot-director
binds assets as i2i image conditions, INJECTS locked CharacterDNA
reference images into every frame render, runs a FACE FIDELITY
GATE (multimodal comparison) immediately before submitting, and
COLOR GRADES all clips for lighting/tone consistency — so a
drifted/hallucinated shot is never sent to the video API.
Passing shots render as FIRST+LAST FRAME (mode=keyframes) videos
via agnes-video-v2.0 with async polling; the final short-drama
ASSEMBLY is deferred (off by default) and done separately via
`assemble-episode`.

Shares the SAME Agnes backend that ToonFlow (AI 短剧工厂) wraps via
its local HTTP API — see "ToonFlow Integration" below for driving
short-drama production through ToonFlow's orchestrator/DB instead
of (or alongside) calling Agnes directly.

Cross-shot / cross-episode consistency is maintained by character
cards, scene cards, prop cards, fixed seeds per asset, and asset
reuse via the catalog. Load this skill whenever the user asks to
produce short dramas, 短剧, 微短剧, 竖屏短剧, or vertical
short-form video content via PavoAPI / Agnes AI / ToonFlow.
skills.name: pavo-drama — AI 短剧生产管线
